operations.title: The eight four-site total-energy nodes have one total-parity defect
operations.body: Exact evaluation of the ten quadrics on the regular C2^3 orbit of eight nodes has rank seven. The unique missing Walsh character is chi_234=epsilon2 epsilon3 epsilon4, giving defect one and a rank-seven global smoothing lattice. This is a coefficient relation on the existing Cayley–Menger carrier, not a new carrier stratum.

operations.title: Benincasa reports the one-dimensional total-parity node defect
operations.body: Entry 1172: the eight generic four-site q_G nodes impose rank seven conditions on quadrics. Their unique defect/relation is the total-parity C2^3 character epsilon2 epsilon3 epsilon4. Hence the smoothing vanishing lattice has rank seven (regular representation minus that line); expected small-resolution Betti numbers are b2=2, b3=6. This is global coefficient topology on the existing carrier, not a new incidence stratum. Physical activation remains unselected.
